title: PC Skill Motion table (model + stance -> animation file)

container.notes: World file type 9 id 5 (name unknown). 10-byte records (s32 model, u16 weapon stance, u16 special character animation, u16 animation file id); header/count position not documented. Runtime copy at [0x02B58188].

records.name: pcSkillMotion
records.where: Records of the PC Skill Motion world file (game file type 9, id 5); in memory at [0x02B58188]. The file header / count position is not documented.

fields.name: model
fields.notes: Model id ((ASCII prefix << 16) | file number, e.g. c = main characters). [src: TK L1190, L940-L958]

fields.name: weaponStance
fields.notes: Weapon stance (battlepack section 0 / BpWeaponStanceList). [src: TK L1190]

fields.name: specialCharacterAnimation
fields.notes: Special character animation id (battlepack section 14 +0x30 uses the same space). [src: TK L1190, L893]

fields.name: animationFileIdentifier
fields.notes: Animation file to use for this model + stance combination. [src: TK L1190]

roundTrip: Edit records in place; keep the (unknown) file header untouched.
Records are 10 bytes, so they are only 2-byte aligned: do not assume 4-byte alignment for `model`.
Hot-reload the file (type 9 id 5) or restart to apply.
gaps: File name, header layout, record count and the record list start offset.
